channel.title: The daily tape · compute.world
channel.description: Monday's conversions come from the neocloud and sovereign-compute edge rather than the hyperscalers. AIB Data Centers says Nebius signed a binding 12-year agreement for 50 MW of critical IT capacity at its southeastern US site, with Nebius prepayments helping fund the build (30 Sep, filed on Form 8-K). AM Intelligence, the Greenko promoters' AI platform, placed firm orders for 20,000 more NVIDIA Rubin GPUs for India and Malaysia, about 70 MW for Q2 2027 delivery, taking its committed total to roughly 29,000 Rubin GPUs and close to 100 MW. The public rental tape is a full six-venue confirm session after the weekend: 69 confirms, 0 ticks, 0 NEW. Lambda holds H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69 / GH200 $2.29; DigitalOcean spot holds B300 $8.00 / MI350X $2.46 / MI355X $2.97; CoreWeave H100 OD $6.16 confirms. AWS Capacity Blocks still banners its 7 Oct rate card while the live table prints current rates (P5 Virginia $5.191). In memory, Micron's fiscal Q4 revenue of $54.23B and a $61.5B guide underline where AI value is pooling. Brookwood's City Council vote on the TCEDA-backing resolution is still pending; Applied Digital has begun baseline sound monitoring at Brookwood Middle School, with no groundbreak primary and the tenant still unnamed. Oracle's Port Washington campus faces a restarted Wisconsin PSC review of its ATC grid connection. PUCT 58481 still effective 10.08.2026; ERCOT RFI due 12 Oct; TCEQ update due 19 Oct; Fermi x TensorWave Matador due 31 Oct.

Countries: United States: Nebius binding 12-year deal for 50 MW critical IT at AIB's southeastern US facility; backed by a 15-year 65 MW electric service agreement (Wire, 30 Sep). India: AM Intelligence firm orders for 20,000 more Rubin GPUs across India and Malaysia (~70 MW, Q2 2027); ~29,000 Rubin and ~100 MW committed in total (Wire, 5 Oct). Malaysia: Malaysia shares AMI's ~70 MW follow-on Rubin tranche with India; site split not disclosed (Wire, 5 Oct). United States / Alabama: Applied Digital Delta Forge 2: baseline sound monitoring at Brookwood Middle School; council TCEDA-backing vote still pending; no groundbreak; tenant unnamed. United States / Wisconsin: ATC grid application for Oracle/Vantage Port Washington refiled after PSC withdrew completeness; Aterio base case partial power Dec 2027 (Signal). United States / Texas: TCEQ data center permit pause still in force; ERCOT RFI due 12 Oct; Abbott update due 19 Oct; PUCT 58481 still 218/219.
